title: Yummy Silky Brazilian Vanilla Pudding
description: A cultured and silky dessert featuring vanilla pod, this kid-friendly Brazilian dish is perfect for any occasion. It is also macrobiotic-friendly and dehydrated to perfection.
instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine the coconut milk, maple syrup, and sea salt, and whisk until the salt is dissolved.
Add the tapioca starch and whisk until it is well combined.
Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until the mixture comes to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes, or until the pudding has thickened.
Remove the pudding from the heat and stir in the dried vanilla pod.
Let the pudding cool to room temperature, then cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours.
Just before serving, scrape out the vanilla seeds from the pod and stir them into the pudding.
Serve the pudding chilled, garnished with additional vanilla seeds if desired.
